title: Conversation Archive Response
description: Public response schema for the archive_conversation workflow. This schema defines the client-facing confirmation returned after archive content has been accepted and stored.

success.description: Indicates whether the archive request completed successfully.

project.description: Project associated with the archived content.

title.description: Human-readable title of the archived content.

start_time.description: Start time supplied for the archived work session. Public examples may use a human-readable time format such as '16:00 uur'.

status.description: Archive status returned by the workflow, such as 'archived'.

summarized.description: Indicates whether the archived content was summarized before storage.

shortened.description: Indicates whether the archived content was shortened before storage.

url.description: Public-safe Notion URL or placeholder for the archived record.
